legend: One day Vasya was going home when he saw a box lying on the road. The box can be represented as a rectangular parallelepiped. Vasya needed no time to realize that the box is special, as all its edges are parallel to the coordinate axes, one of its vertices is at point (0, 0, 0), and the opposite one is at point (x1, y1, z1). The six faces of the box contain some numbers a1, a2, ..., a6, exactly one number right in the center of each face.
The numbers are located on the box like that:
number a1 is written on the face that lies on the ZOX plane;
a2 is written on the face, parallel to the plane from the previous point;
a3 is written on the face that lies on the XOY plane;
a4 is written on the face, parallel to the plane from the previous point;
a5 is written on the face that lies on the YOZ plane;
a6 is written on the face, parallel to the plane from the previous point.

At the moment Vasya is looking at the box from point (x, y, z). Find the sum of numbers that Vasya sees. Note that all faces of the box are not transparent and Vasya can't see the numbers through the box. The picture contains transparent faces just to make it easier to perceive. You can consider that if Vasya is looking from point, lying on the plane of some face, than he can not see the number that is written on this face. It is enough to see the center of a face to see the corresponding number for Vasya. Also note that Vasya always reads correctly the ai numbers that he sees, independently of their rotation, angle and other factors (that is, for example, if Vasya sees some ai = 6, then he can't mistake this number for 9 and so on).
input: The fist input line contains three space-separated integers x, y and z (|x|, |y|, |z| ≤ 106) — the coordinates of Vasya's position in space. The second line contains three space-separated integers x1, y1, z1 (1 ≤ x1, y1, z1 ≤ 106) — the coordinates of the box's vertex that is opposite to the vertex at point (0, 0, 0). The third line contains six space-separated integers a1, a2, ..., a6 (1 ≤ ai ≤ 106) — the numbers that are written on the box faces.
It is guaranteed that point (x, y, z) is located strictly outside the box.
output: Print a single integer — the sum of all numbers on the box faces that Vasya sees.
note: The first sample corresponds to perspective, depicted on the picture. Vasya sees numbers a2 (on the top face that is the darkest), a6 (on the right face that is the lightest) and a4 (on the left visible face).
In the second sample Vasya can only see number a4.

legend.ai: 一天，Vasya 在回家时看见路上躺着一个盒子。这个盒子可以表示为一个长方体。Vasya 很快就意识到这个盒子很特殊，因为它的所有棱都平行于坐标轴，其中一个顶点位于点 (0, 0, 0)，与之相对的顶点位于点 (x1, y1, z1)。盒子的六个面上写有一些数字 a1、a2、...、a6，每个面的正中央恰好有一个数字。
数字在盒子上的位置如下：
数字 a1 写在位于 ZOX 平面上的那个面上；
a2 写在与前一个面平行的面上；
数字 a3 写在位于 XOY 平面上的那个面上；
a4 写在与前一个面平行的面上。
a5 写在位于 YOZ 平面上的那个面上；
a6 写在与上一条提到的平面平行的那个面上。

此刻 Vasya 从点 (x, y, z) 观察这个长方体。求出 Vasya 能看到的所有数字之和。注意，长方体的所有面都是不透明的，Vasya 无法透过长方体看到数字。插图中将面画成透明只是为了便于观察。你可以认为，如果 Vasya 从某个面所在平面上的点观察，那么他就看不到写在该面上的数字。对 Vasya 来说，只要能看到某个面的中心，就能看到这个面上对应的数字。另外注意，Vasya 总能正确读出他看到的 ai 数字，无论这些数字的旋转、角度及其他因素如何（例如，如果 Vasya 看到某个 ai = 6，他不会把它误认为 9 等等）。

input.ai: 第一行输入包含三个以空格分隔的整数 x、y、z（|x|, |y|, |z| ≤ 106），表示 Vasya 在空间中的位置坐标。第二行包含三个以空格分隔的整数 x1、y1、z1（1 ≤ x1, y1, z1 ≤ 106），表示长方体与点 (0, 0, 0) 相对的顶点的坐标。第三行包含六个以空格分隔的整数 a1, a2, ..., a6（1 ≤ ai ≤ 106），表示写在长方体各面上的数字。
保证点 (x, y, z) 严格位于长方体外部。

output.ai: 输出一个整数——Vasya 看到的长方体面上所有数字之和。

note.ai: 第一个样例对应图中描绘的透视图。Vasya 看到数字 a2（在顶面，也就是颜色最深的面）、a6（在右侧面，也就是颜色最浅的面）和 a4（在左侧可见面）。
在第二个样例中，Vasya 只能看到数字 a4。
